    AI Overview
    The 2026 Men’s March Madness tournament is broadcast across four national networks:
    TBS, CBS, TNT, and truTV. The Final Four and National Championship games are scheduled to air on TBS, with simulcasts often available on truTV. Games can be streamed via the March Madness Live app, Paramount+, or Max. 
    Key 2026 Broadcast Information: 
    • Final Four & Championship: Primarily on TBS.
    • First Four: Primarily on truTV.
    • First/Second Rounds & Sweet 16/Elite 8: Split between CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV.
    • Streaming Options:
      • All games: March Madness Live app (requires TV provider login).
      • TBS, TNT, truTV games: Max.
      • CBS games: Paramount+.
      • Live TV Services: Hulu + Live TV, YouTube TV, DIRECTV STREAM.
